stories.headline: Swindon Supermarine moved top of the table following a 6-0 dismantling of local rivals Melksham…
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine moved top of the table following a 6-0 dismantling of local rivals Melksham Town at home. Joe Shepherd put Marine ahead after only two minutes, before their lead was doubled in the 16th minute from Dan Warre.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Round-Up | A historic weekend for Portland United, Tiverton Town end Weymouth’s unbeaten start to the season, and further slip ups at the top of the Southern Premier Central.
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.body: Owen Howe bagged a brace for Tivvy in the 5th and 50th minute, before Tor Swann’s fifth goal in five matches in all competitions for The Terras. It leaves Weymouth in second, three points behind Swindon Supermarine with three games in hand.

stories.headline: Dorchester Town are now three without a win as it was a historic day for…
stories.body: Dorchester Town are now three without a win as it was a historic day for local rivals Portland United , who won 2-3 at The Avenue Stadium. Portland went ahead after 12 minutes via Archie Woolford, three minutes before Ethan Taylor levelled for the home side.

stories.body: Into the second half and the away side moved 1-3 up with goals from Patrick Jenkins and Harley Brook, with Ethan Taylor getting a late goal for Dorchester to move his season tally to 10 in the league.

stories.headline: Portland climb to 11th with the win, with Dorchester remaining third with Westbury United closing…
stories.body: Portland climb to 11th with the win, with Dorchester remaining third with Westbury United closing in after they won their third successive match 0-2 at Paulton Rovers . Jack Witcombe got Westbury ahead after 49 minutes before William Taylor doubled the lead in the 92nd minute.
